correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the index duration, no contact to either susceptible has expectation q=L_a(2λ), and contact to one specified susceptible but not the other has probability p−q for p=L_a(λ). The newly infected person's independent no-contact event contributes p, giving r=2p(p−q). Thus r>0 selects the unique positive quadratic root for p. The nondegenerate Gamma law gives p²<q<p, so the log ratio is in (1,2). Multiplying its derivative by (1+2u)(1+u)log²(1+u)>0 gives 2(1+u)log(1+u)−(1+2u)log(1+2u), negative by strict convexity with H(0)=0. The endpoint limits of the ratio are 2 and 1. Therefore u=λ/a, then a, λ, β from h, and η from β/λ are unique, including both admissible η endpoints. At fixed shape, the m₂ derivative in λ is (q−2p)p′−(1−p)q′>0; the two-mean Jacobian in (β,η) is triangular with diagonal entries nonzero because m₁ grows with β and λ falls with η. This gives exact local fibers at all interior points by the implicit-function theorem. The variance signal has coefficient Var(I)=1/a at second order. I independently checked the rational example and an exact second-shape bracket: at a=2 and β=2(√2−1), m₂(λ=1/2)=269/625 < 82/175 < m₂(λ=3/5)=896379/1827904. Both trial intensities are interior to (β/2,β), so continuity and strict monotonicity give an exact distinct-shape match with h=1/2 and m₂=82/175.
residual_risks: Exact model-image probabilities, known mean duration, single introduction, full follow-up and the stated Gamma and size-scaling families only. The mean-only fiber result is interior; it is not a finite-sample or boundary conditioning theorem.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The qualitative insight is prior and not itself credited. The frozen proof determines the specific probabilities needed, proves uniqueness globally including both mixing endpoints, and proves a local constant-mean family at every interior point. Neither the qualitative suggestion nor the forward recursion establishes those conclusions without the additional shape inversion and Jacobian arguments.

value.rationale: This answers a concrete data-resolution question raised by the motivating likelihood study. In the smallest two nontrivial sizes the two exact means erase information even with perfect estimation, while the household outcome counts allow a unique monotone inverse. The positive variance signal of order λ² explains why population-level uniqueness need not translate into dependable estimation at weak transmission.
residual_risks: Does not classify other sampling designs or the information in mean outcomes at additional household sizes.
